criteria.statement: The one-index NADAC field, fed to the cycle machinery as two identical class slices on the main reading's own pair graph, returns every square exactly 0.0 and every slice cycle inside its float band.

criteria.detail: 3492295 rows in 617 comparison weeks (0 held out with a field that is not a number, 18 with Old not positive); one scale for the whole file (a per cent) leaves 107712 outside; read per week, 599 weeks print a per cent and 18 another scale (01/10/2018 a fraction, 01/17/2018 a fraction, 01/24/2018 a fraction, 01/31/2018 a fraction, 02/07/2018 a fraction, 02/14/2018 a fraction, 02/21/2018 a fraction, 02/28/2018 a fraction, 03/07/2018 a fraction, 03/14/2018 a fraction, 03/21/2018 a fraction, 03/28/2018 a fraction, ...); 737 rows outside the band; worst: NDC 00409797308 week 08/20/2014 old 0.0028 new 0.0 printed -67.14 recomputed -100; NDC 00409797307 week 08/20/2014 old 0.0028 new 0.0 printed -67.14 recomputed -100; NDC 00409713909 week 08/20/2014 old 0.0028 new 0.0 printed -67.14 recomputed -100; NDC 00409613903 week 08/20/2014 old 0.0028 new 0.0 printed -67.14 recomputed -100; NDC 00338000404 week 08/20/2014 old 0.0028 new 0.0 printed -67.14 recomputed -100; out-of-band rows by week: 08/20/2014 5 of 18586, 06/21/2017 360 of 20170, 07/19/2017 372 of 20697; every one is printed in report.B99-1.outside_rows
criteria.name: B99-1
criteria.reading: The publisher's arithmetic reproduces on every row not printed. Each printed row is a place where the printed Percent Change departs from its own definition, read by its week and the shape its rows share; a week is the unit of reading because the scale is set per week. The flag says the object is there: rows were recomputed and every out-of-band row is named by its week.
criteria.statement: Percent Change is recomputed from Old and New NADAC Per Unit on every row, its scale read per comparison week; every row outside the rounding band of the printed digits is printed one by one and named by the week it falls in.

criteria.detail: 35666 NDC-11 in both (390 NADAC NDCs carry no NSDE billing unit, not judged); 0 disagree
criteria.name: B99-2
criteria.statement: On the same NDC-11, NADAC's Pricing Unit and NSDE's Billing Unit agree; each disagreement is named.

criteria.detail: not run on NADAC: NADAC sets one rate per drug grouping, classification for rate setting and pharmacy type and publishes it on every NDC in the group (CMS NADAC methodology, December 2024, p. 6, p. 7, p. 15-16, p. 26), so a repackaged NDC and its source NDC carry one price by construction (D30, third clause: the second price is the first times 1 under a published rule). The wedge would read that rule; on this carrier B99-3 measured the wrong object (D23). It needs a source that prices each labeler's own NDC
criteria.name: B99-3
criteria.statement: The repackaging wedge log(price repack) - log(price source), one per pair at the latest common date, read into one of three named cells, on a price source that prices each labeler's own NDC; on a source that sets one rate per drug group (NADAC) the pair is one price by construction and the criterion carries no verdict.

B99-3 carries no verdict on its carrier: NADAC sets one rate per drug group, so a repack pair is one price by construction (D23, measured the wrong object). The criteria with a verdict are read in full

B99-3.1: printed: the wedge is one constant, which is the unpublished service fee
B99-3.2: printed: two prices for one batch of tablets, spread wider than rounding
B99-3.3: no verdict: too few pairs, or every wedge at or under its own floor, or a price source that sets one rate per drug group or drug product (NADAC, CMS Part D SPUF), where a repack pair is one price by construction
